_comment: PAR, one design per task (decided 2026-11-12: only the simplest algorithm is par; every other proved design is an entry, recorded under a player's handle like any submission). One line per task: `design` is the stem of one of the task's task.json references (the design file; a second proof of the same file is par's too), `algorithm` the words the rules page names it by. Which algorithm is the simplest is the maintainers' reading, written down here so that changing it is one line. Read by leaderboard/leaderboard.py (`par_path`, `par_names`: par of the boards and of check.py's headline, `seed-references`, the reserved handle), site/build.py and the tests; it sits in leaderboard/ because tasks/ holds task directories only. A task without a line has no par.

matmul.algorithm: N x N multiply-accumulate units, one step of the dot products per cycle
